BETWEEN:-
 DEVENDRA S/O HARISHCHANDRA LODHI, AGED  ABOUT 20 YEARS, OCCUPATION: PRIVATE VILLAGE  JAMUN TALAIYA P.S. BALDEVGARH DISTRICT  TIKAMGARH (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VISHAL V.R. DANIEL - ADVOCATE)
 AND
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BALDEVGARH TIKAMGARH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
(BY SHRI PRADEEP DWIVEDI - PANEL LAWYER)
(SHRI SUMIT KANOJIYA - ADVOCATE FOR OBJECTOR)
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
ORDER This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail, pending the trial.

The applicant is in custody since 19.10.2022 in connection with Crime No.298/2022, registered at P.S.-Baldevgarh, District- Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363 and 366-A of IPC.

As per the prosecution story, on 14.07.2022, mother of the prosecutrix lodged an FIR in police Baldevgarh stating that on 13.07.2022 at around 04:00 am her daughter had gone to answer the call of nature but thereafter, she did not come back to her home.
She searched a lot for her but she could not be traced.
FIR was registered.
Almost after three months of the incident.
Prosecutrix was recovered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent.
He has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant is also 20 years old young boy.
He and prosecutrix were having love affairs with each other and had gone to on their own for earning the wages.
It is submitted that in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. prosecutrix has not stated anything against the present applicant.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

On the other hand learned counsel for the objector as well as learned counsel for the State have opposed the grant bail and submitted that at the time of commission of offence, prosecutrix was below 18 years of age they have established physical relations, therefore, offence under POCSO Act and Section 376 of IPC is made out.
Thus, they have prayed for rejection of the bail application.
I have gone through the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. as per her own version she had friendship with the applicant and had gone with him on her own.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed and trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant/accused is not warranted.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant-Devendra be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE vkv /-
